columns.name: INPUT_VALUE_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key column.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display sequence number for the input value.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Element Type Identifier

columns.name: GENERATE_DB_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether database items are generated for the input values.

columns.name: HOT_DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the default value is a HOT default. .

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the input value is required for an entry.  (Validated by a lookup).

columns.name: USER_ENTERABLE_FLAG
columns.description: USER_ENTERABLE_FLAG

columns.name: BASE_NAME
columns.description: BASE_NAME

columns.name: UOM
columns.description: Unit of measure for the input value (hours, monetary amount, etc).

columns.name: USER_DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: USER_DISPLAY_FLAG

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RESERVED_INPUT_VALUE
columns.description: RESERVED_INPUT_VALUE

columns.name: RETRO_STATIC_FLAG
columns.description: RETRO_STATIC_FLAG

columns.name: FORCE_RRV_MODE
columns.description: FORCE_RRV_MODE

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: Default for the input value on entry.  Value may be overridden for an element link, and for specific entries.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Formula to generate the input value

columns.name: RATE_FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Formula used by the Rate Engine to calculate the Rate contribution amount.

columns.name: VALIDATION_OVERRIDE_MESSAGE
columns.description: VALIDATION_OVERRIDE_MESSAGE

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: List of allowable input values

columns.name: MIN_VALUE
columns.description: Minimum value allowed on entry.  May be overridden at the element link.

columns.name: MAX_VALUE
columns.description: Maximum value allowed on entry.  May be overridden at the element link.

columns.name: VO_NAME
columns.description: View object name used to validate the input value

columns.name: VALUE_SET_CODE
columns.description: VALUE_SET_CODE

columns.name: WARNING_OR_ERROR
columns.description: Indicates the kind of message that is generated if the input value is not valid for min/max or formula validation.

columns.name: CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the context. Foreign key to FF_CONTEXTS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.

columns.name: SGUID
columns.description: The seed global unique identifier. Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
